scientific_role: New-substrate C4 falsifier. P0-D remains INCONCLUSIVE due endpoint floor and is not repaired or reclassified. P0-E asks whether the already-demonstrated SkillRL representation sensitivity propagates to final ALFWorld success under the single author-released final RL policy, conditional on an outcome-blind competence gate.

principle_certificate.principle: Endpoint treatment effects are scientifically interpretable only when the reference policy supplies non-degenerate endpoint support. Policy competence is therefore a qualification variable, not a nuisance to be tuned after intervention outcomes.
principle_certificate.falsifiable_prediction: If the author final RL policy has usable final-success support, fresh-ID semantic displacement should change final success more than an identity placebo, while exact semantic quotienting should restore the pristine trajectory/outcome.
principle_certificate.strongest_reduction: Any apparent effect is generic fresh-ID/prompt perturbation or stochastic sampling rather than semantic displacement. C controls fresh-ID/prompt change without semantic-set change; D restores A memory prompt byte-for-byte and reuses A realized stochastic response after prompt identity is verified.

stage_0_competence_calibration.STOP_NO_COMPETENT_POLICY_SUPPORT: If the single author final RL policy fails the frozen support gate, do not launch B/C/D and do not search alternative policies/checkpoints/tasks.
